title: Characters: Lovers, Families, Friends
reason: The video's framing of the Nurse shifting to verse in Act 4 to signal grief is a dramatic performance insight that would not penalise a GCSE Drama student.

pedantry.quote: Shakespeare usually gives her prose to speak, which is the traditional language of servants. But in Act Four, when she thinks Juliet is dead, she shifts into verse.
